premises.text: We need to increase agricultural output by 60% to sustain humanity over the next 25 years.
premises.evidence_span: we're going to need to increase our agricultural output by 60%

premises.text: There is an urgent and unmet need to deliver new and resilient crop varieties to farmers.
premises.evidence_span: We have an urgent and unmet need to deliver new and resilient crop varieties to farmers

premises.text: Current methods for identifying useful genes in crops are inefficient.
premises.evidence_span: only about 14% of the things that they return are actually useful

premises.text: Producing genetically modified varieties is costly and time-consuming.
premises.evidence_span: it's at least five years and up to $100 million to produce even a simple genetically modified variety

premises.text: Natural selection is an efficient method for creating new crop varieties.
premises.evidence_span: inspired from natural selection, which, although it's incredibly slow, is actually really efficient in creating new varieties of crops

premises.text: Our technology can identify causal gene targets with high precision.
premises.evidence_span: allows us to identify causal gene targets with 90% precision

premises.text: Our AI-enabled recommendation system can suggest plant crosses with minimal data.
premises.evidence_span: suggests which plant crosses might produce the traits that we're looking for

premises.text: We can validate our breeding process in a single cycle using existing genes.
premises.evidence_span: validated our process in just one breeding cycle, just using genes that already exist in nature

premises.text: Our technology can economically work on complex crops that were previously unfeasible.
premises.evidence_span: even crops that were too complicated or too costly to work on are now economically feasible for us

value.text: New and resilient crop varieties can be created to support sustainable agriculture.
value.evidence_span: planting the seeds for a greener tomorrow

notes: No separate premises for pilot partners and R&D pipeline as they support the same premise.
